name: Add task priority levels
description: Add priority support (low, medium, high) to todo items. Update add to accept optional priority, and format to show priority indicators.
setup: const testPath = path.join(workspace, 'todo-priority.test.js'); fs.writeFileSync(testPath, `import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { test } from "node:test"; import { add, format } from "./todo.js"; test("add accepts priority and includes it in task", () => { const items = add([], "important task", undefined, "high"); assert.equal(items[0].priority, "high"); }); test("format shows priority indicator for high priority", () => { const items = [{ id: 1, text: "urgent", done: false, priority: "high" }]; const output = format(items); assert.ok(output.includes("❗") || output.includes("HIGH")); }); test("default priority is medium", () => { const items = add([], "normal task"); assert.equal(items[0].priority, "medium"); }); `);
verify: const todoPath = path.join(workspace, 'todo.js'); if (!fs.existsSync(todoPath)) return false; const content = fs.readFileSync(todoPath, 'utf8'); return content.includes('priority') && content.includes('export');
